notes: Only the discourse then is added; every other supplied English word is licensed by a morpheme under rules 15, 33, 44.

The added *then* survives review by rule 42's counting: יַעַן has *Seeing*, אֲשֶׁר has *that*, לָכֵן has *therefore*, and no fourth morpheme answers to it. Folding it into יַעַן would fail rule 30's one-rendering test, exactly as the unit note says. לָכֵן's two morphemes correctly share one unit headed on כֵן.
